title: Decoded descriptor

bodyBlocks.text: SHALE makes the grid SHALE / BCDFG / IKMNO / PQRTU / VWXYZ. Row–column pairs 11 12 13 14 14 35 52 read SHALLOW. REF-B is the matching linked-quarry reference. Its northern public access is the next confirmed setting.
